_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_storable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_storable" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece', "pack_size" REAL NULL, "pieces_per_pack" INTEGER NULL, "piece_label" TEXT NULL, "sealed_shelf_life_days" INTEGER NULL, "opened_shelf_life_days" INTEGER NULL, "default_date_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'best_before', "default_location" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pantry', "restock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("restock" IN (0, 1)), "off_code" TEXT NULL, "nutrients_per100" TEXT NULL, "nutrients_basis" TEXT NULL, "nutrients_source" TEXT NULL, "bls_code" TEXT NULL, "unit_weight_g" REAL NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_barcodes" ("household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ean" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("household_id", "ean"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NULL, "alias_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chain" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NULL, "purchased_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "external_id" TEXT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "sum_mismatch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sum_mismatch" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'article', "raw_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece', "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "line_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_norm_cents" INTEGER NULL, "tax_code" TEXT NULL, "needs_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_review" IN (0, 1)), "excluded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("excluded" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "page_no" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_item_id" TEXT NULL, "ean" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece', "location" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pantry', "purchased_on" TEXT NULL, "best_before" TEXT NULL, "date_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'best_before', "opened_on" TEXT NULL, "open_shelf_life_days" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sealed', "is_suggestion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_suggestion" IN (0, 1)), "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inventory_item_id" TEXT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_delta" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "meal_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "eaten_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lunch', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "servings_eaten" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "servings_made" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "inventory_item_id" TEXT NULL, "free_text" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_g" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "confidence" REAL NULL, "bls_code" TEXT NULL, "nutrient_basis" TEXT NULL, "micros" TEXT NULL, "preparation" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "sugar_g" REAL NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "salt_g" REAL NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_target_rows" ("household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "targets" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("household_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bug_reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bug', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "app_info" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', "severity" TEXT NULL, "resolution" TEXT NULL, "fixed_in_version" TEXT NULL, "status_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Einkaufsliste', "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "free_text" TEXT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece', "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "is_suggestion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_suggestion" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_online_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "linked_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "online_price_cache" ("store" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "base_unit" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_norm_cents" INTEGER NULL, "available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("available" IN (0, 1)), "feed_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("store", "external_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_food_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "bls_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_weight_g" REAL NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Tablette', "micros" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "note" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement_intakes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplement_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "micros" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_prefs" ("household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("household_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_plan_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dinner', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "ingredients" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "source_url" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "remote_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_states" ("remote_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("remote_table"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "key_values" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
